decisions.summary: Step tally by switching cProfile profilers at each listed step's binding (_bind_points); innermost listed step gets the call, else the stage's own work; wrapper and enable/disable calls removed from counts.
decisions.why: Carries the GM's per-step counts ('please do include the per step counts') exactly as FR-001/SC-002/SC-003 settle them. Note: a listed step's calls are only attributed to it if every listed step is bound; an unbound one lands in own work, so T01's binding must cover every Steps: entry.

decisions.summary: One sequential roll measures every stage, giving stage k the fanout's process state.
decisions.why: Implements FR-006's 'process state the fanout's job gives it'. Its premise (profiling and wrappers change no result) is asserted, but T01's and T03's exits test agreement with profile_stage / perf-fanout directly, which enforces SC-003.

decisions.summary: Record dev/phase-calls.json, one entry per map type keyed by settlement form, field archetype, water sink; newest replaces.
decisions.why: FR-002 and the GM's 'most recent counts that happen to have been captured'. The three-knob key is an asserted definition of map type: if a knob deciding which stages do work is missing from it, a newer roll would overwrite an entry holding a stage the newer lacks and drop a captured count against the request. The implementation must confirm the key covers every knob that gates a stage; not a narrowing as written.

decisions.summary: Headings show the reference's calls and share or a dash; another type shown beside, named, where it spent more or holds a stage the reference lacks.
decisions.why: Restates FR-003. 'Every roll runs every stage' is labeled for one stage (waterward, 2 calls, 2026-10-27, perf-fanout LABEL=417-T57) and generalised; it narrows nothing because the GM foresaw near-zero stages ('some of those will be literally zero') and D5 keeps the dash path for a stage no record holds. The dash branch must stay implemented, not pruned on that premise.

decisions.summary: End section id=calls after id=missing: stage table with calls and share, total row, other types beside; each row toggles step rows (calls, share of stage, share of reference total) plus an own-work row; one sentence on innermost-step attribution.
decisions.why: The GM's second and third messages and FR-004: after 'Features this map does not have', click to expand, each step with its own count, share of the stage and share of overall map generation; no time. The '23 stages' figure carries no measurement label and could not be checked under this bundle; FR-004 says 'every stage', so the table must enumerate the page's stage list rather than a hardcoded 23 - a hardcoded count that disagreed with the page would be a narrowing.

decisions.summary: make phase-calls [SEED HOUSEHOLDS FORM ARCHETYPE SINK], reference spec by default; make placement-stages reads the record and needs no measurement.
decisions.why: The GM's 'tooling that is able to not only measure these things, but actually ... insert that kind of table into that document'; FR-001's selectable seed and type.

decisions.summary: Record committed; measuring roll on demand, never in the gate; default artifact the reference spec at 40 households, seed 39 (feature 417's T57 roll).
decisions.why: GM: 'I don't think that we need or even want to literally have that document be always up to date'; the 40-homestead placement 'that we are talking about' is T57's.

decisions.summary: Page's new section in a new module tools/placement_calls.py rather than growing placement_stages.py.
decisions.why: Structure only; changes nothing the GM asked for. The ~910-line figure is unlabelled but decides only file layout, not scope.

decisions.summary: No performance bookends; the measure is checked against the fanout instead.
decisions.why: No generator change; SC-003 carries the check.

decisions.summary: Measure the reference at 40 households and also row, dispersed, polder, dike-pond where a 40-household roll of them stands; regenerate the page.
decisions.why: Fills FR-003's beside-column and the GM's per-type dash rule ('a type that contains the stage'); widens nothing the GM limited, and an unrollable type leaves the dash the GM asked for.

decisions.summary: Tests on stand-in stages and a test record: totals equal profile_stage, steps plus own work equal the stage, headings and rows match, toggle works, dash shown, no time.
decisions.why: Enforcement of SC-001 to SC-004 / FR-005, i.e. of what was asked.
